title: Kiewit Computation Center, Public Terminal Room: John G. Kemeny, Thomas E. Kurtz, Students
creator: Dartmouth Photographic Records (Dartmouth College photographic office; no individual photographer named)
creator_evidence: Catalog citation on the Dartmouth Library exhibit item: "Dartmouth Photographic Records." (evidence/source-page/api-items-3661.json, dcterms:bibliographicCitation)
holding_institution: Rauner Special Collections Library, Dartmouth College
call_number: DA-181, Box 9453, "'User Communications, Computing Services' Photograph Notebook, 1969-1977"
exhibit: Sharing the Computer: How the Dartmouth Time-Sharing System Made Computing (More) Accessible (Dartmouth Library online exhibit, site slug dtss)
original_date_uncertainty: A second, blue-ink verso annotation reads, as best transcribed, "1968 Oct 1969". It may indicate a 1968 to October 1969 range. The catalog date c. 1969 is used; the photograph is NOT dated 1964 by any record.
depicted_event_date: The photograph documents routine terminal-room use of the Dartmouth Time-Sharing System at the Kiewit Computation Center, c. 1969. It does not depict the 1964 creation of BASIC. Kiewit was dedicated 2 December 1966 (Dartmouth ITS history timeline), so the scene cannot be from 1964.
narrated_event_date: 1964 (creation of BASIC, SCRIPT.md:67). Separate from the photo date.
acquisition_method: Unauthenticated HTTPS GET of the archive's own 'original' file URLs published in its public Omeka S API. No account, no terms click-through, no payment, no CAPTCHA, no watermark.

sources: Item title and description: "Kemeny and Kurtz work with students in the Kiewit Computation Center, circa 1969."
Handwritten verso label: "Kiewit Computation Center / Public Terminal Room / John G. Kemeny, Thomas E. Kurtz, / Students / Photographer: Photographic Records / circa 1969"
Blue-ink verso annotation: "Photo Records / Kemeny, Kurtz, + students / 1968 Oct 1969 / [CCE negative]" (transcription uncertain in the last two lines)
identity_evidence.position_mapping: Not provided by any record. The sources establish that both men are in the photograph but do not say which figure is which. This package does not label individual faces.
identity_evidence.hardware_note: A keyboard terminal (center) and a printing terminal (lower left) are visible. No record names the terminal model; none is asserted.

verso_other_annotations: Red-ink reuse labels: "Interface NOV/DEC 1991 / p. 5 middle right / 'Dartmouth undergraduates...'" and "shoot at 64% / crop as shown, to fit / no keyline". Pencil number "878" at upper left. These show the print was reproduced in a 1991 publication.
capture_metadata: EXIF: Phase One iXH 150MP, Capture One 21 Macintosh. The archive holds a far higher-resolution capture; only this 1000 px web derivative is publicly served.
